profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary: I currently work as a Web Developer. I enjoy building software products and to contribute to open source development. I have extensive experience in Drupal and WordPress development.

positions.title: Front End Developer ( Consultant )
positions.description:
• Manage websites and web applications, most of which are on the WordPress platform.
• Ensure high-performance, availability, and managing all technical aspects of the CMS.

positions.title: Web Programmer
positions.description:
Define and implement Drupal site structure, content types, taxonomies, and workflows
Play a crucial role in the design, development, and maintenance of our Drupal-based programs.
collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, designers, and project managers, to ensure the successful implementation of this Drupal-based programs.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
• Helped support the maintenance and enhancements of 40 university websites.
• Worked on new projects with Qualtrics forms – logins etc.
• Assisted with Drupal content management system pages (such as creating tables), the creation of HTML emails, creating redirects for sites that are launching, among other responsibilities.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Implemented modern web applications and maintained legacy web applications built on HTML, CSS, PHP and MySQL.
•	Used web development tools including both front and back-end development to produce quality digital projects. 
•	Developed technical documents, manuals and handbooks to accurately represent application design and code.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Used tools like HTML5, CSS, PHP and WordPress to develop websites, admission forms and landing pages.
•	Responsible for the performance, security and customization of 10+ complex and high-traffic live websites. 
•	Contributed in web marketing projects including SEO, PPC, Social Reputation Management and Email Marketing.

positions.title: WordPress Developer ( Consultant )
positions.description:
•	Created, upgrade and maintain websites, including installing and tweaking themes and developing custom themes.
•	Supported back-end and front-end WordPress development for a diverse collection of client affiliated websites.
•	Responsible for working at every stage of the project lifecycle - from initial brainstorming to coding and completion.

positions.title: Programmer Intern
positions.description:
•	Accountable for setting up DNS records for a newly purchased domains, cPanels and installing web applications. 
•	Redesigned and converted the company’s local database into a modern database using XML and Filemaker Pro.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
•	Designed, developed and implemented a custom Roku TV Channel using Brigthscript, JavaScript and XHML.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Implemented a PHP avatar function that allowed users to customize and upload pictures into their profiles.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
•	Used phpMyAdmin, HTML and JavaScript to develop a form which collected cell phone providers from visitors. 
•	Developed a custom JavaScript and jQuery carrousel slider that displayed and suggested event tickets to users.

volunteerExperiences.description: Designed, developed, tested and implemented the organization's new website.
Responsible for developing a custom website for the organization using the Squarespace platform.
